description: This file contains functions and types related to fetching and processing usage data from Claude (Anthropic) API, including web session handling, API calls, and data transformation.

methods.name: buildClaudeUsageWindows
methods.description: Builds usage windows array from Claude API response data.

methods.name: resolveClaudeWebSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves session key from environment variables or cookies for web API fallback.

methods.name: fetchClaudeWebUsage
methods.description: Fetches usage data from Claude web API using session key.

methods.name: fetchClaudeUsage
methods.description: Main exported function to fetch usage data from Claude API, with fallback to web API if necessary.
